Run SS3 across a set of model directories in parallel

Source: R/run_ss3.R
Run_SS3_Grid.Rd

Runs [r4ss::run()] across multiple SS3 model directories in parallel, using [MSEtool::SetupParallel()]

Usage

Run_SS3_Grid(
  run_dirs,
  exe = "ss3",
  extras = "",
  skipfinished = FALSE,
  workers = NULL,
  parallel = TRUE
)

Arguments

run_dirs

Character vector of SS3 model directories to run.

exe

Character. Name or path of the SS3 executable, passed to [r4ss::run()].

extras

Character. Extra command-line arguments passed to [r4ss::run()] (e.g. `"-nohess"`).

skipfinished

Logical, passed to [r4ss::run()].

workers

Integer. Number of parallel workers, passed to [MSEtool::SetupParallel()]. Defaults to `length(run_dirs)`, capped at [future::availableCores()].

parallel

Logical. If `TRUE`, calls [MSEtool::SetupParallel()]. Default `TRUE`.

Value

Invisibly, `run_dirs`.
